svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xJe5HL-tUzzX3A5tEd4K"> <mxGraphModel dx="7357" dy="3764" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Operator as Main / Operator
 participant M as mission : ExplorationMission
 participant C as colony : Colony
 participant Env as Environment
 participant A1 as scientist : Scientist
 participant A2 as rover : ExplorationRover

 Operator->>M: startMission()
 activate M
 M->>M: submitMission()
 activate M
 M->>C: getActiveMission()
 C-->>M: currentActiveMission
 M->>Env: getState()
 Env-->>M: currentCondition
 M->>A1: isAvailable() & canPerform(this)
 A1-->>M: capableAndAvailable
 M->>A2: isAvailable() & canPerform(this) & getBatteryLevel()
 A2-->>M: capableAndSufficientBattery
 M->>C: checkAvailableEquipment(equipment)
 C-->>M: equipmentAvailable
 M->>C: checkAvailableResources(resources, 30)
 C-->>M: resourcesAvailable
 deactivate M

 alt Validation Passes (Accepted Flow)
 M->>C: setActiveMission(this)
 M->>M: setStatus(ASSIGNED)
 M->>A1: setOnMission(true)
 M->>A2: setOnMission(true)
 M->>C: deductResource(resources, 30)
 M->>M: setStatus(IN_PROGRESS)
 M-->>Operator: true

 loop Each Sol (advanceTime(7))
 Operator->>C: advanceTime(1)
 activate C
 C->>M: progress(1)
 C->>A2: discharge(5)
 C->>A1: increaseFatigue(5)
 opt M.isCompleted() [timeElapsed >= 7]
 C->>M: complete()
 M->>M: endMission(COMPLETED)
 M->>A1: setOnMission(false)
 M->>A2: setOnMission(false)
 M->>C: removeActiveMission()
 end
 deactivate C
 end
 else Validation Fails (Rejected Flow - e.g., Unsuitable Agent / Resource Shortage)
 M->>M: setFailureReason(reason)
 M->>M: setStatus(FAILED)
 M->>C: addMissionToHistory(this)
 Note over M,C: Mission never becomes activeMission
 M-->>Operator: false
 end
 deactivate M",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
